product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice D3 PRO Battery-powered Portable PA Speaker Array System with Class D Amp and Bluetooth Streaming
product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™D3 PRO Battery-Powered Portable PA Speaker SystemClass D amplifier with Bluetooth® streaming and built-in DSPImagine being able to perform anywhere you want to, regardless of the access to an AC outlet. Let's face it, outdoor performances and parties are a part of our lifestyle, now more than ever. The same could be said of presenting and public speaking. Truly, all the world's a stage. The D3 PRO Battery-Powered Portable PA Speaker System is a lightweight and versatile system that delivers an impressive 120 watts of power, thanks to the efficient Class D amplifier design. Whether you're DJing, singing, playing an instrument, or doing all three at the same time, this all-in-one battery-powered system can handle all your audio needs. Having your music or spoken word heard anytime, anywhere, and on the fly has never been this simple.Battery powered with up to 6 hours of playback time120 watts of Class D powerBuilt-in Bluetooth® radio for wireless streamingLightweight design weighs only 16.4 lbs.2 combination XLR/TS inputs with individual switches to select Mic or Instrument input levelsBuilt-in DSP with reverb effect3 mixing channels (2 mono XLR/TS and 1 stereo RCA inputs) BATTERY POWEREDThe built-in rechargeable Lithium-ion battery array has a total capacity of 16500mAh, which gives you up to 6 hours of playback time. CLASS D POWERThe D3 PRO Battery-Powered Portable PA Speaker System has an efficient Class D amplifier, which produces 120 watts (RMS) of power. It features a 60Hz ~ 18kHz frequency response and can pump out an impressive 114dB sound pressure level (SPL). TRUEWIRELESS STEREOThe system features a Bluetooth® radio, so you can jam or sing along with karaoke or studio tracks streamed wirelessly from your smartphone or laptop. And if you're looking for a full stereo solution from a portable, battery-powered PA, this system has you covered. The TrueWireless™ Stereo (TWS) feature allows you to sync a pair of D1 or D3 PRO powered speakers with the touch of a button to produce a true left/right stereo pair. 3-CHANNEL MIXER WITH BUILT-IN REVERBEach of the three inputs has its own volume knobs that allow you to find the perfect mix for your performance. The two XLR inputs also feature individual Bass, Treble, and Effect knobs, so you can fine tune the tone for each of the two inputs. The built-in DSP features an adjustable reverb effect, which makes everything nice, warm, and ambient. TWO MICS OR INSTRUMENTSThe two XLR inputs can be individually set to accept either microphone or instrument level inputs, so you can connect two mics, two instruments, or one of each for your performance. The XLR output sends your post-mix signal to a second D1 or D3 PRO PA speaker or to a multichannel mixing board to make your performance part of a larger audio presentation. THE ULTIMATE ROAD WARRIORThe enclosure's design allows you to place or mount it in a variety of ways to accommodate your various needs and for stages or venues of all shapes and sizes. Mount it to a PA tripod for enhanced projection over a large area, place it horizontally on the ground to serve as a stage monitor, or place it on the ground to project your performace to a smaller crowd. The rugged polypropylene construction ensures years of use under the grueling conditions of the road. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x D3 PRO Portable PA Speaker • 1x AC Power Cord • 1x User's Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
